item.title: Over 70% of farmers invest in diversification to bring in regular additional income
item.description: Almost three-quarters of UK farms have now diversified into other revenue streams. The unpredictability of farming income – fluctuating market prices, extreme weather, rising costs – and the loss of basic payments have prompted 71% of British farmers to launch side ventures that ensure money consistently comes in. item.title: One machine, every season: Honda ATV and UTV work all year round
item.description: Modern farming does not slow down with the seasons; it simply changes pace. From checking ewes during lambing, supporting cows at calving to covering long days in the fields during harvest, farmers need equipment that is reliable, adaptable and built for real working conditions.
